# SmartCounter

> People counting and visitor analytics software for retail stores, shopping centers, and other physical locations in Indonesia.

## Official pages

- [Homepage](https://smartcounter.id/en)
- [Features](https://smartcounter.id/en/features)
- [Retail use cases](https://smartcounter.id/en/use-cases)
- [Packages](https://smartcounter.id/en/packages)
- [FAQ](https://smartcounter.id/en/faq)
- [Blog](https://smartcounter.id/en/blog)
- [Contact](https://smartcounter.id/en/contact)

## Product capabilities

- Visitor entry and exit counting
- Dwell-time and occupancy analysis
- Store heatmaps and in-store route analysis
- Queue and service-efficiency monitoring
- Aggregate demographic estimation
- Multi-location reporting

## Supported retail formats

- Retail and department stores
- Shopping malls
- Fashion stores
- Pharmacies
- Supermarkets
- Premium retail stores

## Company

SmartCounter is a product of PT Ritel Data Indonesia. For current product, compatibility, pricing, privacy, and deployment information, use the official contact page above.
